overview_description.description:
FiftyThree is a provider of collaborative presentation tool used to build the essential tools for future creators. It also offers a productivity app for getting ideas down, and a collaboration app for teams to gather, organize, and share their ideas that help creators make their ideas better.

It was founded in 2011 and is headquartered in New York.
